content: Chasna acpi llaquishca ailluguna, Yaya Dios chasna alita rangaraushcatami ñucanchima rimashca. Chiraicumi ñucanchi aichas ñucanchi shunguhuas mana juchayuc tucungahua tucui mana ali ashcamanda anchurina manchi. Chasna rasha Yaya Diosta manzhasha paihuacpi ali sumacta causana manchi.

Maspas cunan ñucanchitas llaquichi. Ñáucanchiga ima mana alita pitahuas mana rashcanchichu, yachachisha pitahuas mana pandachishcanchichu. Pitahuas mana umashcanchichu. Astahuanbas alitami purishcanchi.
Cangunata culpayachingahua mana chasna rimanichu. Randi manachu ñaupata rimarani canguna ñucanchi shungu ucuibicuinta anguichi nisha. Causaushahuas huañushahuas shugllashina pariu manchi.
Canguna alita rangaraushcata yachasha yapa cushiyani. Ñáucanchi tucui turmintariushcai yapa ashcata cushiyashcamanda ahuantani, shungüibi ashcata yuyarisha yapa cushi ani.

Ñáucanchi Macedonia provinciama shamushca punzhamanda mana samanata ushashcanchichu randi yapa turmintarishcanchi. Mana quiriccunaga ñucanchita llaquinayacta turmintachitucushcanchi. Ñáucanchi shungu ucui quiriccuna ali puriungunachari nisha yuyarishcanchi.
Astahuanbas llaquiriucta cushiyachic Yaya Diosca, ñucanchita cushiyachisha ahuantachira Tito pactamusha cangunamanda cuintacpi.

Mana pai shamushcamandalla cushiyaranchichu astahuanbas canguna paita yanapashcamanda cuintashcatas uyasha cushiyaranchi. Chasnallata canguna ñucata yuyarisha ricunayasha, yanapanatas munanchi nisha cuintashcata Tito rimahuacpi yapa cushiyarani. Chasnallata chi quiric runahua juchamanda canguna llaquiriushcatas cuintahuara. Chitas uyashami yapa ashcata cushiyarani.
Llaquiriushcai Yaya Dioshuan ali tucunata yuyarishun

Ñáuca ñaupa cangunama cachashca quillcata canguna ricusha llaquirishcata yachani. Chasna agllaita ñuca cachashcamanda mana llaquirinichu. Chasna paigunata llaquichishcamanda llaquirini nishami ñaupa rimarani randi cunanga mana chasnachu rimani. Ñáuca yachani canguna chi quillcata ricusha mana unaitachu llaquirishcanguichi.

Cunanga cushiyauni. Cangunata llaquirichishcamanda mana cushiyanichu nini astahuanbas canguna chi jucha rashcata yuyarisha, Yaya Dios munashcacuinta llaquirisha paihuagma bulltiashcanguichi. Chita yachashami cushiyani. Dios munashcacuintami canguna llaquirishcanguichi. Chasna quillcashcamanda cangunata mana imatas huaglichiranchichu.

Yuyarichi. Mana quiric runaga pai rashcamanda llaquirishallata paihua causaita mana alichishaga pai juchata rashcamanda huañungami. Astahuanbas maican quiric runaga juchata rashcamanda Yaya Dios munashcacuinta llaquirisha alichishaga paihua juchamanda quishpichishca tucunmi. Chasna Diospacpi ña ali tucusha mana mas llaquirinzhu.

Ñáa canguna ñuca quillcashcata ricusha Yaya Dioshuan ali tucushun nisha yuyarisha pai munashcacuinta llaquiranguichimi. Chimanda chi juchata cangunahuacpi mana munasha manzhashcanguichi, Yaya Dioshuan ali tucunataga yuyarishun nisha. Chasna alichishun nisha chi juchata rac runata libachishcanguichi. Ñáucata llaquishcamandami ñuca rimashcacuinta ranata munaranguichi. Chasna rasha chi juchamanda alichishcata alita ricuchishcanguichi.

Ñáuca cangunama quillcasha, mana chi juchata rac runaraicu, ni chi juchamanda llaquichitucuctahuas mana yuyarisha quillcaranichu. Astahuanbas canguna ñucanchita alita llaquishcataga Diospa ñaupacpi yachaitucungahua quillcaranimi.

Chimandami cushiyashcanchi. Canguna cadsusha cushi tucushcamanda ñucanchihuas alita yuyarisha ahuantashcanchi. Chasnallata Tito pactamusha canguna paita cushihuan yaicuchisha cuirashcamanda cuintacpi mas cushi tucunchi.

Pai chara caimanda mana rigllaita canguna ali causashcamanda paita rimarani. Chiraicu Tito cangunahuan tiyaushcai canguna rashcamanda mana pingarinichu. Ñáucanchi cangunata sirtu shimita rimashcacuinta paita cangunamanda rimashcahuas sirtu man.
Pai cangunahuagma shamushcai canguna manzhaushallata alita japisha paita alita cadsuranguichi. Chiraicumi pai cangunamanda yuyarisha yapa cushiyan.
Canguna alita cadsuc asha mana manzhashcamanda alita rangaraushcata yachasha cushiyani.
